|errata_history=This is documented image version PC-E2 (version 3 of 4). The current full-face image and supported <code>207_3</code> are on [[Depa Billaba (V) (Errata 2)]]. The source observations establish the documented sequence: original full face, sheet partial known by October 2021, November 2022 full face, September 2023 sheet partial. Capture dates and repository dates do not establish the first publication day of the older faces; the September 2023 date is the printed sheet edition. The partial layouts are separate published images even when the game words match a full face.
* '''Original''' ([[Depa Billaba (V)]]): The original full face is preserved from the Players Committee Holotable repository state <code>022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153</code>, known by 8 July 2018. It prints the dotted bottom label and no errata mark.<ref>[[:File:V7-L-depabillaba-2018-07-08.gif|Published full source face]], 8 July 2018 repository state.</ref> Game text: “If at least two [Light Side] icons here, once during your control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck. If at least two [Dark Side] icons here, may forfeit in place of your hit non-Jedi character present with Depa (forfeit = 0), restoring that character to normal.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Depa Billaba (V) (Errata)]]): The bottom-only sheet face is present in the complete source captured on 5 October 2021. It retains the dotted bottom label and prints no errata mark. Its upper face and artwork are intentionally omitted.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-October-2021-capture.pdf|Official Set 7 source captured 5 October 2021]], page 2.</ref> Game text: “If at least two [Light Side] icons here, once during your control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck. If at least two [Dark Side] icons here, may forfeit in place of your hit non-Jedi character present with Depa (forfeit = 0), restoring that character to normal.”
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The current full face is preserved from the Players Committee Holotable repository state <code>a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5</code>, dated 4 November 2022. The bottom label has no uniqueness dot. It changes “forfeit = 0” to “forfeit for 0” and prints E1.<ref>[[:File:V7-L-depabillaba.gif|Published full source face]], 4 November 2022 repository state.</ref> Game text: “If at least two [Light Side] icons here, once during your control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck. If at least two [Dark Side] icons here, may forfeit in place of your hit non-Jedi character present with Depa (forfeit for 0), restoring that character to normal.”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Depa Billaba (V) (Errata 3)]]): The September 2023 printed sheet edition publishes the bottom-only face with the undotted bottom label and E1.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Official Set 7 sheet, September 2023 edition]], page 2.</ref> Game text: “If at least two [Light Side] icons here, once during your control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck. If at least two [Dark Side] icons here, may forfeit in place of your hit non-Jedi character present with Depa (forfeit for 0), restoring that character to normal.”
'''Before/after published source faces:''' '''Before''' ([[Depa Billaba (V) (Errata)]]): [[File:V7-L-depabillaba-Set7-known-by-2021-10-05-partial.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] → '''After''' (this image): [[File:V7-L-depabillaba.gif|frameless|upright=1.1]].
'''Errata mark:''' this source prints “E1”, whereas the image-version code is PC-E2. This mismatch is recorded as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]]; the printed face is retained unchanged.
